xwikidoc.title: Upgrade Notes
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity output="false"}} ## The product defaults to the one configured for the wiki, and the range of versions is read from the request, so ## that a URL such as ?product=XWiki&from=10.11.9&to=11.10.3 can be shared to point someone at the notes of their ## upgrade. #set ($product = $stringtool.trim("$!request.product")) #if ($product == '') #set ($product = "$!services.releasenotes.getDefaultProduct()") #end #set ($fromVersion = $stringtool.trim("$!request.from")) #set ($toVersion = $stringtool.trim("$!request.to")) ## Every version of the product that has a release note is one an upgrade may start from, whereas only the ones ## marked released are versions an upgrade may reach: the notes of a version still in development may change before ## it ships. Both lists are ordered the way the versions are released. #set ($allVersions = []) #set ($releasedVersions = []) #if ($product != '') #foreach ($note in $services.releasenotes.getReleaseNotes($product)) #if ("$!note.version" != '') #set ($discard = $allVersions.add($note.version)) #if ($note.released) #set ($discard = $releasedVersions.add($note.version)) #end #end #end #set ($allVersions = $services.releasenotes.sortVersions($allVersions)) #set ($releasedVersions = $services.releasenotes.sortVersions($releasedVersions)) #end ## A range can hold hundreds of versions, but only a few dozen notes. The notes are not paged, since they are read ## in the order the versions are released and a page break would split that order: this bound only keeps a wide ## range from loading every change of the wiki, and is reported when it is reached. #set ($upgradeNotesLimit = 500) {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} {{translation key="releasenotes.upgrade.description"/}} {{html clean="false"}}
#foreach ($version in $allVersions) #end
#foreach ($version in $releasedVersions) #end
{{/html}} #set ($rangeVersions = []) #if ($product != '' && $fromVersion != '' && $toVersion != '') #if ($services.releasenotes.compareVersions($fromVersion, $toVersion) >= 0) (% class="box warningmessage" %)((({{translation key="releasenotes.upgrade.invalidRange"/}}))) #else ## The notes of a version apply to the upgrades that reach it: the version upgraded from is left out, since it ## is already installed, and the version upgraded to is kept. #foreach ($version in $releasedVersions) #if ($services.releasenotes.compareVersions($version, $fromVersion) > 0 && $services.releasenotes.compareVersions($version, $toVersion) <= 0) #set ($discard = $rangeVersions.add($version)) #end #end #if ($allVersions.contains($toVersion) && !$releasedVersions.contains($toVersion)) #set ($notReleasedParameters = [$services.rendering.escape($toVersion, 'xwiki/2.1')]) (% class="box infomessage" %)((($services.localization.render('releasenotes.upgrade.notReleased', $notReleasedParameters)))) #end #if ($rangeVersions.isEmpty()) (% class="box infomessage" %)((({{translation key="releasenotes.upgrade.none"/}}))) #end #end #end ## The versions are asked for exactly, and each value is placed into a macro parameter, which is re-parsed as wiki ## syntax, so the list is emitted escaped. #set ($versionFilters = []) #foreach ($version in $rangeVersions) #set ($discard = $versionFilters.add("=$version")) #end #set ($escapedProduct = $services.rendering.escape("=$product", 'xwiki/2.1')) #set ($escapedVersions = $services.rendering.escape($stringtool.join($versionFilters, ','), 'xwiki/2.1')) {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$rangeVersions.isEmpty()) {{getChanges limit="$upgradeNotesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Migration" contextVariable="upgradeNotes"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$rangeVersions.isEmpty()) ## The notes are grouped by the version they were made in, and the versions are displayed in the order they are ## released, which is the order an upgrade goes through them in. Within a version, the notes keep the order of the ## search, the most important ones first. #set ($notesByVersion = {}) #foreach ($noteName in $upgradeNotes) #set ($noteVersion = "$!xwiki.getDocument($noteName).getObject('ReleaseNotes.Code.EntryClass').getValue('version')") #if (!$notesByVersion.containsKey($noteVersion)) #set ($discard = $notesByVersion.put($noteVersion, [])) #end #set ($discard = $notesByVersion.get($noteVersion).add($noteName)) #end #if ($notesByVersion.isEmpty()) (% class="box infomessage" %)((({{translation key="releasenotes.upgrade.none"/}}))) #end #foreach ($version in $rangeVersions) #if ($notesByVersion.containsKey($version)) ## Each version is displayed by its own call of the displayChanges macro, which reads the changes from the ## variable it is given the name of once this script has run, so each version is published under a name of its ## own rather than under one reused variable, which would only hold the last version by then. #setVariable("upgradeNotes${foreach.count}", $notesByVersion.get($version)) #set ($noteReleaseReference = $services.releasenotes.getReleaseNoteReference($product, $version)) == [[$services.rendering.escape($version, 'xwiki/2.1')>>doc:$services.rendering.escape($services.model.serialize($noteReleaseReference, 'default'), 'xwiki/2.1')]] == {{displayChanges displayer="migrationNotes" contextVariable="upgradeNotes${foreach.count}"/}} #end #end #if ($upgradeNotesHasMore) (% class="box warningmessage" %)((( {{translation key="releasenotes.upgrade.truncated"/}} ))) #end #end {{/velocity}}
